_note.text: Episode 5 version 2. Every still is one full painted picture in the Bakunawa look (the JSON prompt of pipeline/draw_pick.py, three draws a key, the choice at 3x). 'full' holds each still's JSON prompt; 'shots' maps every sentence index to its still and its row of shots.md. Silent shots sit on whole lines: shot 16 on 47, 17 on 48, 19 on 51, 22 on 54, 23 on 55, 25 on 57, 28 on 66, 35 on 82, 36 on 83. Must not resemble Episodes 1 to 4: Indio is led down by the sleeve, never pushed; no rain shelter, phone screen, crowd or barred gate; the five in the snow stand still, small, from above. The commissioners are never likenesses and never close; Agoncillo is generic and seen only through his window; Marcela is never shown; the building is no known landmark; the twenty-peso notes are generic. Negative for every draw: flat cel shading, flat even lighting, cartoon, tv animation, thick even outlines, poster, clip art, text, letters, numbers, watermark, extra fingers.
writing: bk_49: write 20,000,000 in dark brown ink, a formal 1898 hand, large, inside the blank pale area in the centre of the document (upper half of the frame); nothing else on the paper.

bk_20: inside the blank pale strip on the orange note, two or three short lines of dark blue handwriting (the words of the marker, only words checked as true, e.g. "Felipe Agoncillo 1859-1941"; nothing from the unchecked marker text), and at the end of the strip one larger handwritten letter M.

bk_93: the question "Ikaw, ka-Indio: kung hindi ka pinapasok sa silid, saan ka tatayo para marinig ka pa rin?" set in the empty night sky of the upper part (about 8% to 40% of the height), above the lit window, clear of the subtitle band at 63%.

bk_07, bk_10, bk_18, bk_73, bk_75, bk_80, bk_88: the twenty-peso notes stay generic (orange, an outline portrait), no letters or numbers added; bk_18 and bk_88 show the note folded, its writing not seen.
bk_15 (and bk_18): the wall plaque stays plain and off-centre; its text is not checked (facts.md: THIN), so nothing is written on it.

writing_done.bk_20: a blue M on the white strip of the note, sign_text.py, serif

bk_54.subject: Following shot from behind and above, the camera at the top of a narrow stone stair looking down it: two figures walking AWAY from the viewer down the steps, both with their backs to us, no faces visible. In front, a tall thin French head waiter of about fifty in 1898, a black tailcoat, slick parted grey hair, seen only from behind; a step behind him, a young Filipino man about twenty, lean, short tousled black hair tied in a small topknot, seen from behind, a long-sleeved white waiter's jacket, black slacks, only the cord of a medallion at the back of his neck, head low. The head waiter reaches back and holds the young man's white sleeve at the elbow, leading him down. No dog. The two backs in the upper half; the lower half is the dark steps going down.
bk_54.setting: a narrow stone service stair in a Paris hotel in 1898 going down to the kitchens, worn steps, a gas lamp, stacked dirty plates at the bottom; no writing anywhere
bk_54.light: one gas lamp above, long shadows down the stair, warm gold behind fading to cold grey below, richly painted, detailed ink linework, textured brushwork
bk_54.note: led by the sleeve, never pushed; silent

bk_55.subject: Medium shot: a young Filipino man about twenty, lean, warm brown skin, short tousled black hair tied in a small topknot, wearing a white waiter's jacket with the sleeves pushed up to the elbows, black slacks, a round bronze medallion on a cord around his neck, a red handkerchief tied on his left wrist, no headband, four small indigo line tattoos on his right forearm, standing alone before a stone sink and towers of dirty plates, a wet rag in one hand, a thumb and four fingers, his other hand on the rim of the sink, looking straight at the viewer, tired and quiet. He is alone, no dog, no animals. His face and the plates in the upper half; the lower half is the sink and grey dishwater.
bk_55.setting: the dish-washing room of a busy hotel kitchen in Paris in 1898, lit by warm oil lamps: a big stone sink, piles of plates, buckets, copper pans on white tiled walls, a wide low window just above the sink looking out onto the snowy street at ground level; no writing anywhere
bk_55.light: a single oil lamp, cold blue light from the small high window, damp shine on the bricks, steam, deep shadows, sad and still, richly painted, detailed ink linework, textured brushwork

bk_56.subject: Low angle from beside the sink, looking up: above the sink a small grimy window at street level, through it horses' legs, carriage wheels and snow passing; beside it, a stocky Filipino seaman of about forty, weathered dark brown skin, close-cropped black hair grey at the temples, a short thick black moustache, kind deep-set eyes, a small gold ring in his left ear, a faded blue-striped collarless shirt with rolled sleeves, a long stained white canvas apron, nodding up toward the window, his hands resting on the sink rim. No dog. The window and Ambo's face in the upper half; the lower half is the sink and the plates.
bk_56.setting: the dish-washing room of a busy hotel kitchen in Paris in 1898, lit by warm oil lamps: a big stone sink, piles of plates, buckets, copper pans on white tiled walls, a wide low window just above the sink looking out onto the snowy street at ground level; no writing anywhere

bk_58.subject: Profile view, the dog facing to the left of the picture: a medium-sized slim black short-haired Philippine street dog with a white chest patch, one folded ear and bright clever eyes, a red kerchief around his neck. The dog's right ear, the one nearest the viewer, is folded over and hangs down limp; the dog's left ear, on the far side, stands up pointed; the dog's face is all black with no white on it, the white patch is only on the dog's chest. He sits on a wooden box under a window, looking up at the window. Through the window only snow and old stone houses. The dog's head and the window in the upper half; the lower half is the box and the wall.

bk_66.subject: Low-angle medium shot, long lens, from the snowy street up into one lit window: a Filipino lawyer of about forty in 1898, brown skin, black hair combed back, a thick black moustache, a dark frock coat over a white high collar, seen small and far through his lit window, a generic figure, no likeness of any real person, alone in a small bare room, sitting at a desk, eyes closed, pressing a folded letter to his forehead with one hand, a thumb and four fingers. bk_82.subject: Very high wide shot looking steeply down from a rooftop onto a narrow snowy street at night: five tiny grown men crossing the street in a short line, seen from far above, their faces too small to see; the first, stocky in a blue-striped shirt and a long white apron, holds an old brass oil lantern with a glass globe high over his head, its warm glow spreading on the snow; behind him a lean young man in a white jacket with a small black topknot, then three men in long white aprons. Their dark footprints trail behind them in the fresh snow. No dog. The small figures and the lantern glow in the upper half of the picture; the lower half is empty untouched snow and the edge of a dark roof.

The bright window in the upper half; the lower half is the dark plain facade and the snow.

bk_84.subject: Top shot from high above, looking down on the snowy street: five small grown Filipino men standing still in the snow in a loose line, all with brown skin and short black hair, all wearing shoes: first a stocky man of forty with a short thick black moustache, in a blue-striped shirt and a long white apron, an old brass oil lantern hanging from one hand at his side; then a lean young man in a white jacket with a small black topknot; then three kitchen men in long white aprons; their faces turned up toward one lit window, arms at their sides. A little apart from them sits a small slim black dog with a red kerchief; the dog's left ear stands upright and pointed, the dog's right ear is folded down. No children, no crowd. The five in the upper half of the picture; the lower half is the empty white snow and their tracks.
